follow-up time: The study duration was from the point of anesthetic administration until the end of the surgery, the specific time was not mentioned.
exposure: 1000 ml of crystalloid/colloid (750/250 ml) combination intravenous fluid preload
cohort: Pregnant women scheduled for elective cesarean section at a tertiary hospital in Nigeria
finding: While crystalloid-colloid combination showed better efficacy in hypotension prophylaxis in the first 10 minutes, there was no significant difference between the combination and colloid alone in hemodynamic parameters beyond 10 minutes.
